question: What is the purpose of the 'AutoFill' feature in MS Excel 3657

options.text: To copy cell content or continue a pattern
To split text into multiple cells
To automatically sum a range of values.

solution:
The correct answer is __**To copy cell content or continue a pattern**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **AutoFill** feature in **MS Excel** is a tool designed to help users fill cells with data, such as numbers, dates, or text, by either copying the content or continuing a predefined pattern.
 
• This feature is widely used to save time and reduce repetitive tasks, as it eliminates the need to manually enter data.
 
• It can handle various patterns like incrementing numbers (e.g., 1, 2, 3), months (e.g., January, February, March), or even custom lists that the user defines.
 
• The AutoFill handle is a small square located at the bottom-right corner of the selected cell or range of cells. Users can drag this handle across adjacent cells to activate the AutoFill functionality.
 
• Examples of AutoFill patterns include **arithmetic progressions** (e.g., 2, 4, 6, 8), **sequential dates** (e.g., 01-Jan-2023, 02-Jan-2023), or replicating text.
 
• Users can also use AutoFill for copying formulas across a range of cells, which dynamically adjusts references based on the relative position of cells.
 
• This tool is part of the broader functionality provided in **Microsoft Excel**, which is a widely-used spreadsheet software for handling data, performing calculations, and creating visualizations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **To validate cell data**__

 __
 
• Data validation is a separate feature in **Excel** that ensures the data entered in a cell meets specific criteria. It is used to control user input, not to copy or fill data.
 
• Examples include allowing only numbers in a cell, restricting values within a range, or requiring a specific format like dates.
 
 
 
• **To split text into multiple cells**__
 __
 
• This function is achieved through the **Text to Columns** feature in Excel. It is used to divide text from one column into multiple columns based on a delimiter, such as a comma, space, or tab.
 
• For instance, splitting "John Doe" into two separate columns for "John" and "Doe."
 
 
 
• **To automatically sum a range of values**__
 
 
• This is done using the **SUM function** or the AutoSum button in Excel, which adds up the values in a selected range of cells.
 
• It is not related to the AutoFill feature, which focuses on copying or extending data patterns.
